title: Real OpenCode generative LLM vs Potion on the frozen synthetic split
question: When the previous fake TF-IDF+LogReg LLM substitute is replaced with the actual OpenCode-accessible generative model yolo-auto/qwen3.8-flash, how do real LLM classification accuracy, calibration, latency, and error patterns compare with Potion/Model2Vec on the same frozen examples?
